facts.fact: The portal of the civil registration and vital statistics system is published under the National Directorate of Registries and Notaries of the Ministry of Justice, Constitutional and Religious Affairs; the page gives no date, so the document's published year is used.

The portal's menu carries birth and death registration, a search of records, and statistics and maps for both births and deaths, with a login for authorised users; the page gives no date, so the document's published year is used.

systems.country_label: Sistema Electrónico de Registo Civil e Estatísticas Vitais (e-SIRCEV); Sistema de Registo Civil e Estatísticas Vitais
systems.owner: Direcção Nacional dos Registos e Notariado, Ministério da Justiça, Assuntos Constitucionais e Religiosos
systems.tiers: Not stated; a web portal with public statistics and a login for authorised users

note: A landing page of navigation only: it does not say which offices enter records or how.
